text: Can drinking too much water hurt you?
One: never. Two: only dirty water. Three: yes, if you drink it too fast.
Your kidneys have a speed limit.
Drink much faster, and the extra water dilutes your sodium.
Your cells swell, even in your brain.
Headache, nausea, confusion. In rare cases, it's deadly.
Did you get it right? Send this to someone who chugs water.
